SELECT
  T2.element,
  COUNT(T2.element) AS tally
FROM 'carcinogenic_molecules.csv' AS T1
INNER JOIN 'csv/atom.csv' AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE
  T2.atom_id = '4'
GROUP BY
  T2.element
